branches = d['branch']
gencost = d['gencost']

Rreq = float(d['reserve_requirement'])

n_gen = len(gens)
n_br = len(branches)

Pd = [float(b[2]) for b in buses]
slack = None
for b in buses:
    if int(b[1]) == 3:
        slack = int(b[0]) - 1
        break

gen_on = [int(g[7]) for g in gens]
Pmax = [float(g[8]) for g in gens]
Pmin = [float(g[9]) for g in gens]

# cost coefficients (MW basis): cost = c2*P^2 + c1*P + c0
c2 = [0.0]*n_gen
c1 = [0.0]*n_gen
c0 = [0.0]*n_gen
for i in range(n_gen):
    r = gencost[i]
    model = int(r[0]); nc = int(r[3])

        elif nc == 2:
            c1[i] = float(r[4]); c0[i] = float(r[5])
        else:
            c0[i] = float(r[4])
    else:
        # segment model: not expected; treat first segment linear
        print("WARNING: block cost model", model, "for gen", i, file=sys.stderr)

# branches
fbus = [int(br[0]) - 1 for br in branches]
tbus = [int(br[1]) - 1 for br in branches]
br_on = [int(br[10]) for br in branches]
X = [float(br[3]) for br in branches]
rate = [float(br[5]) for br in branches]  # MVA rating; use as MW limit in DC
# susceptance
b = [ (1.0/X[k] if X[k] != 0 else 0.0) for k in range(n_br) ]

print(f"sum Pmax = {sum(Pmax):.1f}, sum Pmin = {sum(Pmin):.1f}")
print(f"sum reserve_capacity = {sum(rcap):.1f}")
print(f"gens with status!=1: {sum(1 for s in gen_on if s!=1)}")
print(f"branches off: {sum(1 for s in br_on if s!=1)}")
print(f"branches with zero rating: {sum(1 for r in rate if r==0)}")
print(f"branches with zero X: {sum(1 for x in X if x==0)}")
print(f"zero c2 gens: {sum(1 for v in c2 if v==0)}")

        out[i] = s
    return out

buses = d['bus']
gens = d['gen']
branches = d['branch']
gencost = d['gencost']
rcap = [float(x) for x in d['reserve_capacity']]
Rreq = float(d['reserve_requirement'])

n_bus = len(buses)
n_gen = len(gens)
n_br = len(branches)

# bus index = bus_number - 1 (verified contiguous 1..N)
Pd = [float(b[2]) for b in buses]
slack = None
for b in buses:
    if int(b[1]) == 3:
        slack = int(b[0]) - 1
        break

# generators
gen_bus = [int(g[0]) - 1 for g in gens]
gen_on = [int(g[7]) for g in gens]
Pmax = [float(g[8]) for g in gens]
Pmin = [float(g[9]) for g in gens]

# cost coefficients (MW basis): cost = c2*P^2 + c1*P + c0
c2 = [0.0]*n_gen
c1 = [0.0]*n_gen
c0 = [0.0]*n_gen
for i in range(n_gen):
    r = gencost[i]
    model = int(r[0]); nc = int(r[3])
    if model == 2:
        if nc >= 3:
            c2[i] = float(r[4]); c1[i] = float(r[5]); c0[i] = float(r[6])
        elif nc == 2:
            c1[i] = float(r[4]); c0[i] = float(r[5])
        else:
            c0[i] = float(r[4])
    else:
        # segment model: not expected; treat first segment linear
        print("WARNING: block cost model", model, "for gen", i, file=sys.stderr)

fbus = [int(br[0]) - 1 for br in branches]
tbus = [int(br[1]) - 1 for br in branches]
br_on = [int(br[10]) for br in branches]
X = [float(br[3]) for br in branches]
rate = [float(br[5]) for br in branches]  # MVA rating; use as MW limit in DC
# susceptance
b = [ (1.0/X[k] if X[k] != 0 else 0.0) for k in range(n_br) ]

print(f"n_bus={n_bus} n_gen={n_gen} n_br={n_br} slack={slack+1} baseMVA={baseMVA}")
print(f"total Pd = {sum(Pd):.2f} MW, Rreq = {Rreq} MW")
print(f"sum Pmax = {sum(Pmax):.1f}, sum Pmin = {sum(Pmin):.1f}")
print(f"sum reserve_capacity = {sum(rcap):.1f}")
print(f"gens with status!=1: {sum(1 for s in gen_on if s!=1)}")
print(f"branches off: {sum(1 for s in br_on if s!=1)}")

            p = Pmin[i]
        if p < Pmin[i]: p = Pmin[i]
        elif p > Pmax[i]: p = Pmax[i]
        tot += p
    return tot

tot_hi = P_of_lambda(hi)
